system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Lucy Park launched Remote Desktop Connection targeting DC-HD-01 from WS-LPARK-01; the client recorded a TCP connection attempt to the domain controller on port 3389.
Lucy Park also connected by RDP to FILE-HD-01, where a successful remote-interactive logon for her account was recorded.

The DC access attempt is concerning in light of the stated practice that remote administration is performed only from WS-OHADDAD-01, but the available records do not establish that Lucy successfully logged on to the DC or performed administrative actions there.
A Dropbox client process started under Lucy Park's account. The records show a valid Dropbox signature for a loaded library, but do not show that the client transferred files.
Lucy Park's browser accessed Slack, which is not among the organization's approved services; the provided records show page and supporting-resource requests, not message contents or data transfer.
The GlobalProtect client launched under Lucy Park's account, but these records do not show a VPN connection.

known_telemetry_limitations: DC-HD-01 winsec and Sysmon collection was unavailable from 13:30 through 14:10 UTC, overlapping the alert time; account-management and DC-side logon or process evidence for that interval may therefore be missing.
The provided records do not include an account-creation event for tmp.rwong or records establishing its group membership, privileges, or creator.
The available client records establish an RDP connection attempt to DC-HD-01, but not a successful DC logon or subsequent activity.
claims_not_established: Whether tmp.rwong was created as described in the alert, who created it, and whether it was created through an authorized workflow.
Whether tmp.rwong was added only to Temp-Staff or received any elevated privileges.
Whether Lucy Park successfully accessed DC-HD-01 or performed account-management actions there.
Whether Dropbox or Slack was used to upload, share, or otherwise transfer organizational data.
Whether GlobalProtect established any remote connection.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain DC-HD-01 account-management and authentication logs for 13:20–14:20 UTC, including the creator, timestamp, group membership, and privilege changes for tmp.rwong.
Check directory audit records or other authoritative account inventory data to confirm the account's current and initial memberships and privileges.
Obtain FILE-HD-01 session and file-access evidence, and any available DC-side RDP authentication records, to determine what Lucy Park did during the remote sessions.
Review proxy, endpoint, or cloud audit records for any Dropbox or Slack uploads or other data transfers, and network telemetry for any GlobalProtect connection.
